name: dropdown-menu-demo
title: Dropdown Menu demo
description: An account menu with groups, shortcuts, a submenu, a disabled item and a destructive action.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; import { DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuShortcut, DropdownMenuSubContent, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from '@/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu'; /** * An account menu: labelled groups, shortcuts, a submenu, a disabled item * and a destructive action, reporting what was chosen. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-dropdown-menu-demo', imports: [ Button, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuShortcut, DropdownMenuSubContent, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuTrigger, NdIcon, ], template: `

{{ chosen() }}

My account
Profile ⇧⌘P
Billing ⌘B
Settings ⌘S
Team
Invite users
API (coming soon)
Log out ⇧⌘Q
Email
Message
`, }) export class DropdownMenuDemoExample { protected readonly chosen = signal(''); /** * Reports what was chosen. * * @param action - The item's name. */ protected choose(action: string): void { this.chosen.set(`Chose ${action}.`); } }
